Tejaswini leads CivicDataLab's partnerships and programme delivery in Odisha, working where data and technology meet the everyday systems of state governance. Based in Bhubaneswar, she brings twelve years of experience across education, youth livelihoods, agritech and CSR, with a focus on turning policy into on-ground action in eastern India.

She began her career as a Gandhi Fellow with Piramal Foundation, working on Principal Leadership Program across government schools in Surat, Gujarat to improve student learning outcome. She went on to build the Gandhi Fellowship's presence across eastern India with Piramal Foundation, and later led state transformation work in Odisha by engaging with more than 20,000 youths. There, she helped Department of School & Mass Education set up the Vidya Samiksha Kendra, a data-driven monitoring cell for public schools, and worked with the ST & SC Development Department designing and implementing a fellowship for tribal districts. As State Lead at Learning Links Foundation, she managed large scale CSR-funded education programmes. She then led youth skilling and enterprise partnerships for the Global Opportunity Youth Network at Lighthouse Communities Foundation, built university partnerships across four states for DADB (German Academy of Digital Education), and also worked in aligning climate-resilient farming technology with Agriculture Department, Odisha.

Tejaswini holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Management from HDF School of Management and a bachelor's degree in Business Administration from Fakir Mohan University along with a Certification in Designing Effective Facilitation from Azim Premji University. Guided by humility, collaboration, integrity and empathy, she has travelled to more than 25 states and union territories and enjoys telling stories through social media. She is passionate about personal finance and investments while she enjoys educating young individuals about it.
